stances_toward.note: Germany is the state's firmest European backer on the Dodik question: it supported the High Representative's decisions, banned Dodik and two aides with Austria in May 2025, sponsored the Srebrenica resolution (with Rwanda) and sent Wadephul to Sarajevo on 16 Nov 2025 with the message 'no progress without meeting EU requirements'. Germany is also Bosnia's first trading partner (12.5% of total trade by FIPA's reading) and the main destination of its emigrants. Schmidt, a German, was High Representative; his departure under US pressure is a Berlin loss, hence stable, not warming. Bond affinity through the diaspora.

Friction is real - Berlin's Green Deal and the 2035 engine ban are what the Babiš cabinet attacks, and the cabinet's migration and Ukraine-funding lines differ - but it does not change the structure; Czech security and industry sit on the German side. Bond - affinity: dependence, shared border, centuries of exchange.

stances_toward.note: NATO and EU co-member and Croatia's first trading partner (14.7% of imports, 12.7% of exports in 2025). Plenkovic framed the deal as the shift from Eastern to Western military technology. Bond - affinity, not kinship.

stances_toward.note: NATO and EU co-member and the largest neighbour, aligned out of necessity with visible friction: the compensation claim (the PiS government's USD 1.3tn demand of 2022; Tusk in Dec 2025 said the 1950s waiver does not reflect the will of the Polish nation; Merz says the matter is settled), the Polish court's refusal to extradite the Nord Stream suspect (Oct 2025), and a defence agreement signed on 17 Jun 2026 that adds no mutual-defence guarantee and was scaled back for fear of the president's veto. Warming because Bundeswehr engineers work on East Shield (from 22 Jun 2026), a joint Baltic command is planned, the intergovernmental consultations took place on 1 Dec 2025. Bond - grievance: 1939-45. The reading 'reluctant ally' is the brief's: co-members with friction.
